nodes.label: CLAUDE.md: Project guide and non-negotiables
nodes.rationale: Central project documentation defining architecture principles, development workflow, and system non-negotiables

nodes.label: GLUE: Local-first DJ music library
nodes.rationale: Builds music collection from DJ libraries and folders; analyzes quality, BPM, key; manages playlists and events; evolved from Speklone spectral forensics

nodes.label: Speklone: Spectral forensics (hi-res verification)
nodes.rationale: Original project for hi-res forensics; now becomes GLUE's per-track Inspector and Analyze a File mode

nodes.label: GLUE Home: Tauri 2 tray app engine
nodes.rationale: Desktop background engine on user's computer; writes library and analyzes songs; website uses it as disk and engine over local link

nodes.label: ADR 0002: No GLUE server that sees your music
nodes.rationale: Privacy non-negotiable: server never accesses music; accounts optional; audio only between user's own computers

nodes.label: ADR 0009: JSON files, no database
nodes.rationale: GLUE folder stores JSON files directly; no server or database; user owns their data

nodes.label: ADR 0010: Never write into another app's library
nodes.rationale: v1 limitation: GLUE imports from DJ apps but never modifies their libraries; protects user's original data

nodes.label: ADR 0051: GLUE Home as engine and disk
nodes.rationale: GLUE Home runs as the library engine on user's computer; website uses it as disk and engine over local link; one writer at a time via lease

nodes.label: ADR 0007: OS access only through src/platform/
nodes.rationale: Isolates OS interaction (browser handles, GLUE Home disk access) in one module; enables testing and portability
